localPath.finding: Control persistence, snapshot preparation, session binding and Runtime transport are sub-second in the retained matrix. Most first-text time occurs after Runtime acceptance.

reasoningEffort.finding: Alternating fast and balanced samples did not show a stable fast-mode latency advantage on either retained target.
reasoningEffort.decision: Keep balanced as the product default to avoid an unsupported quality tradeoff.

implementation.reason: The measured local path is already below the acceptance targets and the dominant latency is Runtime/model dependent.
implementation.existingOptimizationValidated: Pi and Codex retain and resume their native session instead of rebuilding managed history on every turn.

boundaries: These are local observations for the listed models, account, host and exact Runtime images; they are not provider-wide latency guarantees.
The first feedback metric covers MyBay lifecycle feedback. First visible text remains dependent on Runtime, provider, model, prompt and service load.
Automatic model warm-up was not added because it would consume provider quota and create hidden native conversation state.
No certification level was changed by this acceptance.
